task.title: Check dependencies and integration points affecting key-based pop-ups
task.shortdesc: Ensure all required plugins, transforms, and editor features are correctly integrated to render key-based keyword pop-ups.

step.cmd: List the toolchain components involved (DITA-OT version, editor, preview engine, custom plugins, CI build scripts).
Verify the DITA-OT version supports your key usage pattern and that all custom plugins are installed and enabled.
If using an editor (e.g., Oxygen), confirm the transformation scenario uses the root map and that keyref resolution is enabled for the framework.
Check whether a custom HTML/JS layer is responsible for rendering pop-ups and confirm it is included in the output.
Validate that any resource-only topicrefs or external keydefs are reachable (paths correct, files included in build inputs).
Re-run with a minimal plugin set to isolate whether a plugin override is suppressing pop-up generation.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
